federal_grants.title: SNAP Employment & Training Program
federal_grants.description: Provides funding to states for employment and training programs that help SNAP recipients gain skills, training, work experience, and job placement assistance.
eligibility_bullets: No matching funds required for participants

federal_grants.title: Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)
federal_grants.sponsor: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
federal_grants.description: Helps low-income households pay for heating and cooling costs. Benefits are provided directly to eligible households or to energy vendors on their behalf.
eligibility_bullets: Household income at or below 150% of federal poverty level
Must be responsible for home energy costs

federal_grants.title: Federal Pell Grant
federal_grants.description: Need-based federal grant for undergraduate students. Unlike loans, Pell Grants do not have to be repaid. Maximum award for 2024-2025 is $7,395.
eligibility_bullets: Must demonstrate financial need via FAFSA
Must be enrolled in eligible degree program
No repayment required - it's a grant, not a loan

federal_grants.title: TEACH Grant
federal_grants.description: Provides up to $4,000 per year to students who plan to become teachers in high-need fields at low-income schools.
eligibility_bullets: Must agree to teach 4 years in high-need field
No repayment if teaching commitment fulfilled

federal_grants.title: Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant (FSEOG)
federal_grants.description: Campus-based grant for undergraduate students with exceptional financial need. Priority given to Pell Grant recipients.

foundation_grants.title: Kresge Foundation Arts & Culture Program
foundation_grants.description: Supports arts organizations building creative capacity in underserved communities. No matching requirement for planning grants.
eligibility_bullets: Demonstrated track record in arts programming
No matching funds required for planning grants

foundation_grants.title: Gates Scholarship
foundation_grants.description: Full-ride scholarship for outstanding minority high school seniors from low-income households. Covers full cost of attendance not covered by other aid.
eligibility_bullets: High school senior from low-income household

foundation_grants.title: Walmart Community Grant Program
foundation_grants.description: Local grants of $250-$5,000 for nonprofits serving communities where Walmart operates. Focus on hunger relief, workforce development, and disaster response.
eligibility_bullets: Organization must operate in a Walmart service area

foundation_grants.title: Target Circle Community Giving
foundation_grants.description: Quarterly grants to local nonprofits selected by Target Circle members. Focus on education, basic needs, and community safety.

state_programs.title: Ohio Family and Children First (OFCF) Council Grants
state_programs.sponsor: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
state_programs.description: Grants for organizations serving at-risk children and families in Ohio. Covers prevention, early intervention, and family support services.

state_programs.title: Ohio College Opportunity Grant
state_programs.description: Need-based grant for Ohio residents attending Ohio colleges. Awards up to $7,500 annually for eligible students.
eligibility_bullets: Expected Family Contribution of $2,190 or less

state_programs.title: Cal Grant
state_programs.description: California's largest state financial aid program. Provides grants up to $14,296 for eligible California students.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum 2.0-3.0 GPA depending on grant type

state_programs.title: New York Tuition Assistance Program (TAP)
state_programs.sponsor: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation
state_programs.description: Grants for eligible New York residents attending approved schools in New York State. Awards up to $5,665 annually.
eligibility_bullets: Enrolled full-time at approved NY institution

state_programs.title: Texas Public Educational Grant (TPEG)
state_programs.description: Need-based grants for Texas residents attending public colleges and universities. No repayment required.

disability_assistance.title: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
disability_assistance.description: Monthly cash benefits for disabled adults and children with limited income and resources. Not a loan - no repayment required.

disability_assistance.title: ABLE Account Program
disability_assistance.description: Tax-advantaged savings accounts for individuals with disabilities. Contributions up to $18,000/year without affecting SSI eligibility.
eligibility_bullets: Eligible for SSI/SSDI or meet disability criteria
Not a grant but tax-advantaged savings

disability_assistance.title: State Vocational Rehabilitation Services
disability_assistance.sponsor: U.S. Department of Education / State VR Agencies
disability_assistance.description: Free employment services for individuals with disabilities including job training, education, job placement, and assistive technology.
eligibility_bullets: Have a physical or mental disability

veteran_assistance.title: Post-9/11 GI Bill
veteran_assistance.description: Provides education benefits for veterans who served after September 10, 2001. Covers tuition, housing, and books.
veteran_assistance.amount_description: Up to full tuition + monthly housing allowance
eligibility_bullets: Served at least 90 days after September 10, 2001

veteran_assistance.title: Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E)
veteran_assistance.description: Provides job training, employment assistance, and education support for veterans with service-connected disabilities.

veteran_assistance.title: Aid and Attendance Pension
veteran_assistance.description: Additional monthly pension for wartime veterans who need help with daily activities or are housebound.
eligibility_bullets: Meet income and net worth limits

nonprofit_grants.title: AmeriCorps State and National Grants
nonprofit_grants.description: Grants for organizations to engage AmeriCorps members in service activities. Members receive living allowance and education award.
eligibility_bullets: Match requirement may apply for some programs

nonprofit_grants.title: United Way Community Impact Grants
nonprofit_grants.description: Local United Way chapters provide grants to nonprofits addressing education, income, and health priorities in their communities.
eligibility_bullets: Align with local United Way priorities
